digest.component_or_area: bridge fsck command and store auditing
propositions: Remove orphaned, duplicates, and stale phantom SYNC output cells from bridge fsck structured output and human report, updating all consumers including CLI, schema, MCP model, docs, and tests in a single shippable change.

Detect unknown event types through a checkout-free two-stage ref scan using git grep and git show against refs/heads/tickets, handling both spacing variants and failing closed on Git/ref errors with RebarError(returncode=2).

Add store_integrity as a new alerting offline cell that validates forward and reverse binding consistency with six specific finding types, requiring exact Jira keys and matching local IDs, with findings making CLI exit 1.
Define Git failure semantics such that missing Git executable, missing tickets ref, malformed output, git grep exit >=2, or candidate-read failure raise RebarError(returncode=2) mapped to CLI exit 2.
Preserve unknown_event_types as a non-gating upgrade warning and keep binding_drift as informational, while store_integrity findings become the fail-closed authoritative integrity check.
Remove SYNC-only scan machinery including _STALE_THRESHOLD_NS, _NS_THRESHOLD, _to_ns, --now-ts, and associated fixtures while retaining BRIDGE_ALERT event paths and bridge-status compatibility.
